match.userMessage: A warm, gravelly man in his sixties, slow and dry.

json.text: [clears throat] Well now, good to see ya. Been a long day, hasn't it? Just sittin' here, watchin' the world go by. [short pause] Folks are always in such a hurry these days. Me? I prefer to take my time. No need to rush things. Life's a marathon, not a sprint, as they say. [exhales softly] Just enjoyin' the quiet, you know? That's the good stuff.
